title: The First Lunation
summary: The Academy is stopped in its afternoon, and the guild is one candidate and a book. Out past the gate the world is moving, and the Grand Conjunction is twelve moons off. The Register suggests learning the way around before the first moon turns.

objectives.text: Open the guild's ledger in the Grand Hall
Look over your cards in the Sanctum
Go out to the world map
Win a fight in the field
Pass time to the new moon
